scripts.export:zip: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$temp = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'spielo-v1-export'; if (Test-Path $temp) { Remove-Item $temp -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temp | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'client','server','package.json' -Destination $temp -Recurse; Remove-Item (Join-Path $temp 'server/utils') -Recurse -Force; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $temp '*') -DestinationPath 'spielo-v1.zip' -Force; Remove-Item $temp -Recurse -Force"
